AnnounceChanges.label: Announce changes in chat
AnnounceChanges.description: When someone applies a change, every online player who may edit settings gets a chat line saying who changed what.

HiddenPlugins.label: Hidden plugins
HiddenPlugins.description: Plugin ids (Group:Name) to leave out of the window. Edit config.json to change this list, then run /modsettings reload.
